summary: globals.py is a constants-only module defining path variables for the WAI processing pipeline. No functions, classes, or callable APIs are exposed.
constants: WAI_PROC_MAIN_PATH - Path to the wai_processing parent directory
WAI_PROC_CONFIG_PATH - Path to the wai_processing/configs directory
WAI_PROC_SCRIPT_PATH - Path to the wai_processing/scripts directory
WAI_SPOD_RUNS_PATH - Path to the spod_runs directory on the filesystem
